Auto Ninja is the ultimate ninja platform game that dares you to conquer 41 trap-filled chambers with sharp reflexes and puzzle-solving skills. 

Your mission? Steal all three coins hidden in each chamber to unlock exclusive ninja skins and show off your mastery.

With simple but tight controls, dynamic level design, and a steady ramp in difficulty, Auto Ninja delivers an intense, addictive experience that tests your agility, timing, and wit. Play now and rise to the challenge!

title: Archers Random
description:
Archers Random is a fast-paced stickman archery game that tests your reflexes and aim.

Fight endless enemy waves, explore new areas, and earn coins to unlock helmets, armor, and triple arrows. Upgrade speed, damage, health, and arm power, master 12 special arrows like fire, poison, rocket, and electric, face epic bosses, and survive nonstop action.

Play solo or challenge a friend in 2 Player mode on the same device for intense head-to-head battles.

title: My Cake Shop: Bake & Serve
description: Run your own sweet bakery in My Cake Shop! Bake and stack colorful donuts, clean messy floors, and serve hungry customers. Expand across the world by unlocking new bakery locations and upgrading machines. Manage crowds, grow your patisserie empire, and become the ultimate idle arcade tycoon!

title: Foot Hospital
description: HELP! Doctor, I hurt my feet, ouch! It is so painful!Could you please help me to cure my feet? I know you have the best medical tools here!

title: Cozy Garden Idle
description: Unwind with this soothing and adorable place. Reveal, pick, and nurture attractive plants to extend your garden and provide more oxygen!

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2025
description:
In "Car Mechanic Simulator 2025", you are a master restorer who breathes new life into forgotten cars! 

Your task is to find old, broken, and abandoned cars, disassemble them down to the last screw, repair them, replace parts, and reassemble them, turning rusty piles of metal into shiny legends of the automotive industry. Search for rare spare parts, restore engines, choose the perfect paint, and bring every detail to perfection.

title: Squid Game: Craft Runner
description:
Join the fun in Squid Game Subway Craft! Craft your way through obstacles and race along the railway tracks in a Minecraft-style world. Face exciting challenges, meet cool characters, and show your skills as you survive the ultimate test in this action-packed game inspired by Squid Game!"

Let me know if this works for you!se!

title: Tricky Arrow
description: Get ready to sharpen your skills in Tricky Arrow! Test your precision and reflexes as you shoot arrows at a spinning circle target. Aim for the bullseye and avoid hitting other arrows. With each twist and spin, the challenge grows, requiring strategy and accuracy. Simple yet addictive gameplay for all ages.

title: Escape From Tung Tung Sahur
description: Escape From Tung Tung Sahur is a fast-paced runner-platformer where quick reflexes are your only chance of survival! You play as a lone runner escaping the bizarre and relentless anomaly known as Tung Tung Sahur. Sprint across platforms, leap over deadly gaps, and avoid sudden obstacles. With intuitive one-touch controls, the game is easy to play but challenging to master. Each level introduces new platform layouts and jump timing that push your skills to the limit.

title: Hangman Saga
description: Challenge your vocabulary with Hangman Saga! With thousands of levels, each word includes a category hint to guide you—like "Profession" for "Doctor." Guess the letters wisely, but too many mistakes end the game! Need help? Use the hint button for a clue. Perfect for all ages, this fun and educational word puzzle will keep you entertained while sharpening your spelling skills. Can you solve them all?

title: Bubble Shooter GO
description:
Pop. Match. Dominate.
Step into the world of precision and strategy with the ultimate bubble shooter experience.

Solo Mode – Play at your own pace or push your skills to the limit. Chain powerful combos, unlock boosters, and master every level as you progress through increasingly challenging stages.

1v1 Battles – Challenge a friend or face off against opponents. Use smart angles, fast reflexes, and well-timed power-ups to outplay your rival in intense bubble duels.

title: Pick Brainrot: 3D Battle
description: Choose one of two Brainrots, transform into them, and engage in intense battles with other players. Defeat opponents and unlock new abilities: a Brainrot morph, unique weapons, and powerful abilities. Every battle is a chance to prove yourself! At level 5, you'll unlock a protective shield, and at level 10, you'll unlock slow-motion , which will give you a huge advantage in battle. Earn titles for your victories, from "Noob" to a true "Pro"!

title: Dino Hunter King
description: Action-packed FPS games have long attracted players. Enjoy dinosaur hunting in Dino Hunter King. Enter a wild prehistoric world, become an elite hunter tracking powerful dinosaurs across open grasslands.

title: Traffic Jam Hop On
description: In Traffic Jam: Hop On, challenge your strategy thinking and quick reflexes! This wonderful puzzle game will take you into a colorful parking lot. Your task is to help all kinds of vehicles get out of traffic jams and start smoothly.

title: Ship Parking Game
description: Solve colorful passenger seating puzzles on ships in this unique traffic jam puzzle game. Help passengers find their seats based on color patterns while managing the flow of people through parking lot-style challenges. It's not just about parking - you're a traffic director managing passenger jams on the high seas.

title: Uno Online
description:
UNO Online is a strategy card game. In the game, the first player to clear his hand will become the winner. In order to win, you need to guess the deck of cards in your opponent's hands and  arrange your card order reasonably. There are also function cards in the game. When you draw a function card, think about how to turn the situation to your advantage. You can use color cards to
change the color of the game, or use +2 cards to make your opponent's cards never run out.

title: Crab Guards
description: Fight through waves of relentless crab-masked enforcers using a deep arsenal—from AKs and SMGs to sniper rifles, shotguns, pistols, flamethrowers, and melee. Master recoil, ADS zoom, and reload timing, earn cash, unlock new gear, and survive through the Crab Guards.

title: Falling Dummy
description:
Push the dummy off the roof of the tallest building on the construction site and watch it break all its bones. Control the body of the little man as he falls and break as many limbs as possible!

Do you want to relax after a hard day? Then this game is made for you! In this anti-stress game, your main goal is to make the dummy break as many limbs as possible when falling from tall buildings!

title: Merge 3D - Match 3 Balloons
description: Your goal is to help the house, floating in the sky on a variety of colorful balloons of different shapes, to land on the ground. Clicking on the balls, you move them to the cells at the bottom of the screen. Collect three identical ball objects in a row to make them disappear, freeing up space and bringing the house closer to the ground. Grandpa is sitting on the roof, and when the house finally lands, he will be happy to celebrate the victory!

title: Sudoku
description: Sudoku is a relaxing yet challenging number puzzle game made for Jio feature phones. Fill the 9×9 grid with numbers 1 to 9 without repeating any in a row, column, or 3×3 box. Choose from different difficulty levels and test your logic skills. The game works offline, saves your progress automatically, and offers smooth performance with clean visuals for KaiOS devices.

title: Tap Car
description:
Unveil stunning car masterpieces by solving image puzzles. Every tap reveals more of the picture—can you uncover them all? A must-play for car enthusiasts and puzzle lovers alike!

Would you like a few more variations depending on the tone you're aiming for (like more casual, exciting, or elegant)?

title: Brainrot Boing Boing Merge
description:
Welcome to Brainrot Boing Boing Merge – a charming merge puzzle game where adorable creatures meet polished gameplay and juicy physics!

Merge. Match. Maximize
Satisfying Effects & Lively Details
Unlockable Skins System
Relaxing Yet Strategic

If you love satisfying merges, juicy feedback, and charming characters, this game is for you. Play now and see what creature you’ll create next!

title: Magic Finger
description: Magic Finger 3D is a casual physics game where you use your magical powers to defeat alien foes creatively. Use your magic touch to throw enemies at each other, utilize explosive barrels for big impacts, and send adversaries off platforms. Control your surroundings by picking up and manipulating objects, becoming the ultimate magic user.

title: Last Stand Warrior
description:
A thrilling third-person shooter where you play as an experienced shooter defending your land from endless hordes of enemies. Control the hero, apply precise punches, use skills and fight with waves of mobs to prevent them from breaking through. Upgrade your weapons and abilities to become a true defense champion!

Ideal for fans of dynamic gameplay, arcade battles and survival in the «wave of opponents» mode.

title: Sticker Puzzle Book
description: Step into the captivating world of Sticker Puzzle, where creativity and strategy come together in a beautifully immersive experience. Explore a vibrant sticker book filled with artistic challenges, visual storytelling, and mind-bending puzzles. Designed as a peaceful chromatic retreat, Sticker Puzzle blends the calming satisfaction of sticker art with the engaging thrill of strategic problem-solving — the perfect harmony of relaxation and mental stimulation.

title: Heroic Knight
description: Guide the noble knight through peril and claim the treasure! In this exciting puzzle game, you'll shift barriers to clear a path to victory. Help the knight defeat enemies, avoid traps, and uncover hidden riches. Plan your moves carefully, as one wrong decision could cost you the treasure!

title: Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D
description: Challenge your mind with Tap Away Block Puzzle 3D! This relaxing logic game offers a satisfying brain teaser. Your mission: tap blocks to clear the screen. It's tricky blocks only move one way! Swipe to rotate the puzzle, find the right order, and watch them fly away. Puzzles get tougher as you go, perfect for training your brain. This free-to-play 3D puzzle is your ideal mental escape. Ready for the challenge? Start tapping now!

title: Food Merge
description: ​Food Merge is a game where you combine different foods to create delicious dishes and serve them to hungry customers. Merge ingredients quickly and strategically to before the time runs out! Each level brings new challenges, faster orders, and more complex combos. Can you keep up and become the ultimate food master?

title: Brainrot Merge Drop Puzzles
description: Drop and merge Italian Brainrot. Trallallero Trallala, Tum Tum Tum Saur, Boneca Ambalabu and more. Play funny memes. Drag and drop memes.

title: Hero Rabbit Idle Survivor RPG
description: We are rabbits! A fun offline survival shooting RPG game starring a rabbit!Hero Rabbit is an offline game. Players can play games anytime, anywhere without connecting to WiFi and the Internet.

title: Palkovil The Way Home
description: Explore the magical world of Palkovil! Battle monsters, solve puzzles, collect toys, and uncover secrets. Feed pets, defeat bosses, and save the New Year in this festive adventure. Dive into quests and bring the Christmas tree home in this exciting online game!

title: Mission Santa: Deliver the Gifts
description:
Santa must deliver gifts to children in time! There are many kids and only one Santa, so everything has to be done on the fly! Fly in a sleigh on Christmas night and throw gifts down chimneys to make children happy. 

The game helps you feel the atmosphere of the approaching holiday and prepare for the most magical time of the year!

title: Survival master: 456 Challenge
description: Surval master: 456 Challenge is a sequel where participants undergo unique survival tests, facing moral dilemmas and dangers. Are you ready for the challenge?

title: Climb Up!
description: In this challenging adventure, you'll embark on a perilous ascent up a massive, treacherous mountain. Navigate slippery surfaces and unpredictable obstacles as you make your way towards the summit, where eternal glory and a rewarding gift await. Will you be able to overcome the many hurdles and reach the top, or will the climb prove too daunting? Your determination and skill will be tested as you brave the unknowns of this grueling climb.

title: Water Sort - Collections
description: Sort, pour, and relax! Complete each level by filling bottles and unlock beautiful collectible images. Test your logic, calm your mind, and build your own gallery as you master the art of sorting water!

title: Crazy Bar Brawl
description: Crazy Bar Brawl ?? throws you straight into the most chaotic, hilarious, and action-packed bar battles ever! If you’ve ever wondered what would happen if you walked into a bar full of drunk troublemakers ?, flying bottles ?, wobbling chairs ?, and wild characters who can barely stand… well, now you can experience it ALL—safely, virtually, and with maximum comedy!

title: Bingo Halloween
description: A Halloween-themed bingo game where you can win exciting bingos to unlock spooky candy-themed images. Enjoy multiple call speeds and progressive unlocks.

title: Thread Match
description: Immerse yourself in the world of Thread Match — a unique and exciting puzzle where you sort colorful threads to complete embroidery patterns. Unravel layers of palettes, carefully working your way down to reveal hidden threads. Use logic and strategy to avoid running out of moves. But be careful — the color palette can be tricky, and every choice matters!

title: Nubik Courier An Open World
description: Become a top pizza delivery expert! Race through city streets, dodge obstacles, and switch between vehicles to deliver pizzas on time. Earn money, upgrade your gear, and master exciting challenges. Fast-paced, fun, and addictive—start delivering now!

title: Foxy Eco Sort
description:
Join Foxy and Raccoon on their eco-mission! Sort waste, play match-3 and matching pairs to clean polluted locations. 

But it's not just cleaning! Uncover the conspiracy of cunning Ratty who wants to destroy the forest. Complete story chapters: track garbage trucks, expose arsonists and save your home!

title: Erase the extra element
description: Sharpen your focus and logic in Erase the Extra Element! Erase parts of each scene to reveal clues and solve tricky visual puzzles.

title: Granny's Classroom Nightmare
description: Step into the eerie halls of Granny's Classroom Nightmare, a horror survival game that blends the terrifying atmosphere of Granny Horror with the unsettling chill of an abandoned school. Trapped in an old, decaying classroom with Granny as your relentless pursuer, you must uncover hidden clues, solve twisted puzzles, and avoid her watchful gaze to escape. Each room holds a dark secret from a haunted past, and the slightest noise can summon Granny

title: Paws Off My Clues!
description:
Explore unique locations filled with hidden objects and unexpected mysteries. From sunny beaches to the ancient ruins of Persia, every corner of this fluffy world comes to life as you hunt for hidden treasures.

Watch as the cats go about their lives, adding charm and humor to the atmosphere, while you search through their delightful mess. Solve puzzles, progress through levels, and become the ultimate hidden object master!

title: Rollance Going Balls
description: Welcome to the wonderful world of Rollance Going Balls. This is an exciting and casual platform game. Control your colorful ball and roll it across a variety of well-designed platforms. Each jump and roll is like a “Rollance” performance full of luck and skill. Watch out for moving hammers.

title: Mini Games Puzzle Collection
description:
Mini Games: Puzzle Collection is an addictive collection of mini games, including 3 of the most popular puzzle games. You need to use limited wooden planks to build a bridge to help doge eat
bones on the other side of the river, draw lines to send donuts to doge. You can also experience the day of a stall owner, satisfying the needs of customers exactly. These fresh and interesting challenges require you to use your brain and solve them one by one through logical thinking.

title: Garden Block Puzzle
description: A neglected garden, overrun by weeds and dried flowers… it can't stay like this! Test your wits, place the bricks strategically, complete each level and bring your garden back to life. Have fun playing and create the perfect space to relax.

title: Noob Village Tower Defense
description: Dive into the dynamic world of a 2D platformer, where you play as a noob fighting for the survival of your village! Your main goal is to protect the village from endless waves of monsters appearing from an ominous portal. Control the tower manually: select shells, adjust the trajectory and shoot enemies one by one. Only your accuracy and tactics will help you survive the onslaught!

title: Big Block Blast
description:
Place triangles and blocks to build 2x2 BIG BLOCKS! Drag and drop shapes into the grid to complete full squares made of triangles. Matching colors gives you bonus points, so in Big Block Blast you must aim for smart and colorful combos!
Some blocks have special powers and can even be placed on top of others. Use them strategically to unlock new moves and clear space. Big Block Blast is a simple to play game but tricky to master! How many BIG BLOCKS can you make?

title: Ludo World
description: Experience endless fun with various vibrant environments, where every roll of the dice brings a new challenge. Choose between classic or quick mode, progress along the trophy road, and prove you're the master of the board with every move you make.

title: Polygon Space
description: Polygon Space is an intense shooting challenge. Fly a laser cannon in space, battle attacking sci-fi shapes, keep firing, upgrade weapons with resources, destroy them all, and stay safe.

title: Find 6 Differences – Spot the Hidden Changes!
description: Put your observation skills to the test in Find 6 Differences, a fun and relaxing puzzle game! With 20 unique levels, each featuring two nearly identical images, your goal is simple: find the 6 differences before time runs out! 20 challenging levels with beautifully designed images and engaging gameplay that sharpens your attention to detail. Hint system to help you when you're stuck.

title: Molang Match'n Munch
description:
Join Molang and Piu Piu in a heartwarming match-3 adventure! Travel the world, collect rare ingredients, and solve sweet puzzles to save the lost recipes in the Great Book of Flavors before they vanish forever!
Travel through the world's greatest real and imaginary cities, collect rare ingredients, and solve delicious match-3 puzzles to advance and save these culinary treasures!

title: Cute cat's adventures
description: An adventure game for girls about a cat, with whom you have to go in search of kittens. Colorful levels await you, filled with traps, obstacles and secrets, as well as dangerous enemies who will try to prevent you from completing your main goal.

title: Unscrew Wood Puzzle
description: Unscrew Wood Puzzle: Screw Jam is an engaging puzzle game that combines logic, strategy, and dexterity in a tactile experience. Players are challenged to solve intricate puzzles involving bolts, nuts, and screws. With hundreds of unique levels, this game provides a blend of relaxation and mental stimulation, perfect for casual gamers and puzzle enthusiasts alike. The beautifully designed wooden and metallic elements create a visually appealing and satisfying gameplay experience.

title: Nitro Speed Car Racing
description:
Nitro Speed Car Racing is a very unique racing game. You need to focus on the pointer on the dial and stop it at the right moment to get the Nitro that can help you rush to the finish line. This
is a test of your quick reaction ability. Of course, you can use the coins you collected in the game to upgrade your engine and nitro. Come to a brain contest, stimulate your dopamine, and
challenge your reflex limit!

title: Mighty Run
description: Mighty Run is an action-packed platformer where you jump, dodge obstacles, and defeat enemies to progress. Collect gifts along the way and reach the end to grab the diamond, unlocking the next level. Use power-ups, master tricky jumps, and overcome challenges in this thrilling adventure. With smooth controls and exciting gameplay, every level is a test of skill. Can you collect all the rewards and reach the finish line? Play Mighty Run now and prove your skills!

title: Elytra Flight
description: Elytra Flight is an endless flying adventure inspired by the legendary Elytra wings. Players take to the skies in a fast-paced challenge where reflexes and strategy decide how long they can survive. Whether solo or in 2 player mode, the game blends arcade action with survival mechanics, offering a fresh and rewarding experience every flight.

title: GT Drift Most Wanted
description:
Drift your way around each level and hit all the snow piles while avoiding barriers. With responsive controls and a focus on timing and precision, players must master their drifting skills to clear each stage and become the ultimate Drift Master.
In this game, players can purchase different cars, each offering a unique driving experience. There’s no customization—just pick your favorite car and hit the track!

title: Master of 3 Tiles
description: Step into a fresh take on classic Mahjong! Your mission is clear: find matching tiles, gather sets of three, and clear the board. Each level ups the challenge, sharpening your skills as you progress. Ready to conquer every board and prove your mastery? Let the tile-matching adventure begin!

title: Mahjong Pet Quest
description:
Dive into the colorful and engaging world of Mahjong Pet Quest, a fun and relaxing puzzle game where classic Mahjong meets adorable animal tiles!
Replace the classic Mahjong tiles with cute animal-themed ones! Each tile brings a charming, delightful touch to the game.
Explore a variety of levels, each designed to test your skills and logic. The difficulty increases as you progress, ensuring that you’re always challenged!

title: Number Domination
description: Number Domination is a turn-based strategy card game where players compete to claim tiles on the board using number cards (0-9). Create chains of three or more, match pairs, or make a "Perfect 9" by summing two cards to 9. Each successful move earns points and claims tiles. At the end, each occupied tile grants an extra point to its owner. Play in Face the Challenger or Face the Champion mode and win with smart moves. Think ahead, outplay your opponent, and dominate the numbers!

title: Hospital Inc
description: Step into the fast-paced world of Hospital Inc, an exciting management simulator. This addictive idle tycoon casual game lets you build, expand, and manage your own hospital while earning profits even when you're away.

title: The Flowers: Merge and Sell Bouquets
description: Combine flowers in the relaxing atmosphere of a summer garden and earn coins! Sell your bouquets to customers and clear your garden of unwanted flowers with your pruning shears! Earn more coins than other players to take a place on the leaderboard!

title: Blocks Breaker
description:
Shoot Blocks break Blocks, upgrade your the tiny car to make it shoot faster to break more blocks!!!


Get coins with every block you break!

title: Valentines Love Link
description: Valentines Love Link is a cute and relaxing matching puzzle game full of hearts, roses, chocolates, and love symbols. Connect matching Valentines items with straight lines, allowing up to two turns. Beat the clock across 48 levels by collecting all tiles and enjoy a sweet romantic theme.

title: Hexon Rush
description:
Hexon Rush is a time limited puzzle game with a little bit of sci-fi look.

Main goal in the Hexon Rush is connecting all the lines inside the hexagonal tiles before time runs out.  There are 600 levels with increasing size, difficulty and complexity.

Don't worry, you will have two types of helpers to solve these puzzles. Be careful when you spend them because they are hard to obtain.

title: Melon Drop: Fruit Merge Master
description: Dive deep into the vibrant and enthralling world of fruit-matching with our exciting game, Fruit Merge: Juicy Drop Game! ??? When the same fruits collide, they merge into a larger fruit. Your mission is to smartly pair the same types of fruits to make the biggest possible fruits without letting them overflow from the container. However, as the fruits grow in size, space becomes a premium - managing it effectively is your key challenge. Can you strategize and solve this fruity puzzle?

title: Small Wardrobe
description: Small Wardrobe is a casual game designed specifically for cotton dolls. Collect and create beautiful and cute dresses for your cotton dolls, and experience heartwarming and fun stories. The game offers a variety of adorable doll clothes, shoes, and accessories. Let's happily organize and tidy up the doll's wardrobe together!

title: Zombie Shooting King
description: The apocalypse is here! Hordes of zombies are swarming the streets. You are the last line of defense. Grab your gun, sharpen your shooting skills, and unleash unstoppable firepower to survive. Shoot fuel tanks, airdrops, and more to get more firepower to destroy tons of zombies. Get diamonds to upgrade your talents like Guardrail, ATK Boost, Crit Rate, or Coin earning!

title: Cars with Guns: Wasteland Showdown
description:
Accept the challenge of the post-apocalyptic wasteland. Take on contracts, earn money and reputation, and collect valuable loot.
Survival belongs to those with the fastest ride and the biggest gun.

title: Construction Simulator
description: Ready to build big and drive even bigger. Construction Simulator brings you into the most realistic world of construction driving simulation. Designed for boys who love mechanics, speed and challenges.

title: Fill One Line
description:
Dive into the world of fascinating logic and test your mind in an exciting puzzle! Your task is to draw a line across the entire playing field, filling it completely, but keep in mind: there will be obstacles on the way that you need to bypass.

The game offers many levels, from simple to incredibly difficult, allowing each player to choose a suitable challenge.

title: iTileZen sort puzzle
description: iTileZen Sort Puzzle  is a fresh and addictive puzzle game that blends the strategic color sorting mechanics with the satisfying tile-matching gameplay. Moves  colorful tiles to complete objectives before time runs out! Whether you love logic puzzles or fast-paced matching challenges, this game offers the best of both worlds.

title: Kaboom Miner
description:
A fast-paced logical arcade inspired by classic Boulder Dash, but taken to the next level with massive chain explosions.
Your goal is simple—but dangerous: destroy all 50 explosive crates. Use falling stones, carefully placed bombs, and clever terrain manipulation to trigger devastating chain reactions. Every move matters. Push stones, move crates, build bridges from bricks, and even trap the Ghost before finishing it off.

title: Crazy Bike Stunts PvP
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning muscle car through 2 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Crazy Bike Stunts PvP!

title: Hidden Object Rooms Exploration
description: Explore a variety of rooms and find hidden items! With 18 levels and 6 items to discover in each room, enjoy the thrill of searching through different spaces like living rooms and more. Drag the screen to explore them. Get ready for an exciting adventure in 'Hidden Object Rooms Exploration'!

title: Bubble Shooter HD 3
description: Bubble Shooter HD 3 is the long-awaited third sequel to the the legendary Bubble Shooter game. Bubble Shooter HD 3 features the classic Bubble Shooter HD gameplay with a set of fresh new bubbles, the option to choose between the arrow vs pointer when shooting bubbles as well as the mighty BOMB feature that lets you blow up 15 bubbles at once. So what is the highest score you can achieve? Enjoy Bubble Shooter HD 3 now and break a new record!

title: Paper.io 2
description:
Conquer as much territory as possible and beat the competition.
A smooth drawing experience!

Use your paper block to steal the area from your online opponents in this game. Capture as much space as possible and try to get the highest score in the lobby. If you move outside your own color, your tail becomes exposed. You will be eliminated when someone manages to catch your tail. So you need to take risks to expand your colored area.

title: Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo
description: Welcome to Ink Shop: Dress & Tattoo, a unique and immersive game that lets you unleash your inner tattoo artist. This isn't just any game; it's your gateway to a world where art meets relaxation, and where your creativity can truly shine. Prepare to immerse yourself in the satisfying and intricate process of tattooing, all at the tip of your fingers!

title: Dragon Draw Joust
description: Prepare for a wildly creative showdown in Dragon Draw Joust, where your imagination becomes your strongest weapon! Instead of choosing gear from a menu, you must draw your own tools to defend your warrior and survive intense combat challenges. Every match feels fresh because your strategy starts with your creativity. Your creation instantly becomes part of your character, helping you block attacks or strike opponents inside the chaotic battle arena.

title: Tiny Fighter - Unstoppable Run
description:
10 Levels of an exciting and action-packed game that brings player to a mysterious woods and castles. The game begins with a dramatic scenario in which a vampire has stolen the princess and the brave Tiny Knight is the only one who can save her.

As the princess is abducted, the Tiny Knight embarks on a quest to retrieve her by through dangerous woodlands and battle his way through the castle's maze. Along the journey, the knight must fight Orcs, Skeletons and win Dracula to save the princess!

title: Gas Station: Junkyard Tycoon
description: Build Your Dream Gas Station and Garage Tycoon Empire! Take charge in Gas Station Simulator Inc., the ultimate game for oil tycoon enthusiasts, idle games managers, and aspiring entrepreneurs! Manage, rebuild, and expand the gas station simulator, clean up your junkyard, and fix cars in this immersive and rewarding gas station simulator.

title: Toca Avatar My Hospital
description: The hospital in the town has received many patients. Come to the town medical center with doctors to treat the patients! You need to use equipment to examine the patient, determine the cause, and administer treatment. Just choose your favorite role and drag them to different consulting rooms to treat them.

title: Fun Obby Extreme
description:
Are you ready to experience an extreme game Fun Obby Extreme is a 3D parkour type game, little Obby needs you to help him jump across the platforms and reach the goal of each level.

Explore a sprawling city, level up and unlock new equipment, all while honing your parkour skills along the way!

title: Goo Goo Gaga Clicker
description: Goo Goo Gaga Clicker is a fast, satisfying idle clicker built around one of the internet’s newest chaotic obsessions: the “Goo Goo Gaga” meme. Goo Goo Gaga Clicker takes the addictive, dopamine-fueled mechanics of Brainrot Clicker and gives them a surreal makeover.  What starts as a simple tap session quickly turns into a full-on collection grind where every click pushes you closer to the next weird, iconic form!

title: Wonders of Egypt Mahjong
description: Wonders of Egypt Mahjong transports you to the mystical world of Ancient Egypt in this brand-new Solitaire Mahjong game. Play through beautifully designed hand-drawn tiles featuring Egyptian motifs and captivating backgrounds inspired by the wonders of Egypt. With 40 unique new layouts and three smaller tutorial layouts, it’s perfect for both beginners and Mahjong experts. Dive into hours of challenging gameplay and uncover the secrets of the Pharaohs!

title: Word Solitaire
description: Challenge your mind with a fresh twist on a classic with Word Solitaire! This addictive word solitaire blends clever word-building with strategic card gameplay, creating a unique solo experience. Find categories, reveal hidden words, and clear the board in increasingly challenging levels. Perfect for quick breaks or long sessions—relax, think, and master the art of words!

title: GT Traffic Racer
description: Skid the wheels of 6 awesome cars with insane speed limits and drive them through 3 landscape highways without crashing. Show how well you can steer the wheels of these amazing cars with roaring engines and conquer 3 awesome game modes. Use replenishing nitro to overtake slow cars and drive in speed at all times. Customize and upgrade your cars with the best upgrades and get the most out of all the cars. Are you ready to show your driving skills?

title: Football Rush 3D
description: Football Rush 3d is a fast-paced, one-touch soccer game that puts you in the boots of a solo football hero. Forget complex controls—just tap, strike, and score! Whether you’re curving shots from midfield or charging down the pitch with speed boosts, every moment is packed with action.

title: Block Sniper
description:
Pixelated sniper action game where you have to complete various missions in a blocky world. 
Game where you are a sniper who performs various missions in a block-based world.

title: Superhero Phone Simulator
description: Explore action-packed mini-games, customize your hero, and test your skills in fun challenges. Whether you enjoy racing, creativity, or exciting adventures, this app has everything you need for endless fun!

title: Match Ten Number Puzzle
description: Ready to put your brain to the test in a fun and relaxing way? Match Ten - Number Puzzle is a clever puzzle game that combines simple rules with surprisingly deep strategy. Once you start, you won’t want to stop! As levels progress, the board becomes more complex, and every number choice matters. Plan carefully, think ahead, and keep the board under control! If you enjoy number-based puzzle games, this one is a must-play!

title: Void Orbit
description: Void Orbit is an addictive space arcade game where you orbit a central core and dodge incoming enemies. Tap to reverse direction and survive as long as possible! Unlock cool skins, dynamic themes, enjoy challenging modes like Echo Mirage and Tower Build. Multi-language support for global players. Free to play, endless fun!

title: Dino Egg Shooter
description:
Dino Egg Shooter is a fun and addictive puzzle game set in a colorful prehistoric world.
With 100 levels of increasing difficulty, players aim and shoot colorful dino eggs to clear the board. 
Each level presents unique challenges, from tricky formations to limited shots.
Easy controls and charming visuals make Dino Egg Shooter perfect for all ages.
So, get ready

title: Brainrot Cleaning
description: Welcome to Brainrot Cleaning, the weirdly satisfying cleaning simulation that turns chaos into calm. In this fun and quirky casual game, your job is to scrub away the mess caused by the wild world of brainrot characters and their hilarious antics! In the Cleaning Italian Brainrot or the Underwater mode, you will finish various cleaning tasks.

title: Hit ball
description:
Hit ball is a fast-paced arcade game with roguelike elements, in which you fight off waves of enemies with ricocheting balls! With each shot you break through obstacles, knock down monsters and earn experience to improve your abilities.
Dozens of levels with unique traps, walls, boosting balls and dangerous bosses await you. Collect boosters, pick up abilities, regenerate health and strategize to survive the battle!

title: Mr Bounce
description: Challenge yourself with Mr Bounce, the brain-boosting puzzle game that will test your thinking skills and reflexes. Each level is a new puzzle demanding strategic planning and precise execution. Mr Bounce is more than just a game; it's a mental workout that improves your cognitive abilities.

title: Save The Sheep
description: Save The Sheep offers an immersive mental challenge as you step into the shoes of a shepherd. Relentless wolves have invaded your flock, seeking to feast on your precious sheep. Safeguard your flock by strategically placing wooden stakes to separate them from the predators. Experience the electrifying thrill of rescuing sheep and demonstrate your unmatched intellect in this captivating game.

title: Stumble Guys
description: Stumble Guys is a very hot adventure elimination game. A variety of fun levels await your challenge, and the time has come to test your memory and dexterity! Run, sprint, and slide to overtake your opponents and dodge the obstacles that keep popping up. Can you survive to the end? Invite your friends to join you and kill them all!

title: NG: Flow Lines
description: Flow Lines is an engaging and straightforward puzzle game where the main objective is to connect dots of the same color through a continuous path on a grid.

title: Fun Town Parking
description: Funtown Parking is an exciting parking simulation game where you must follow paths and park in designated spots while avoiding obstacles and challenges. As the levels progress, the routes become more complex, testing your precision and driving skills. Can you navigate through the chaos and park without a scratch? Take on the challenge and master every level!

title: Data Diggers
description:
Merge USBs, choose blocks, download data, get money,and buy USBs
Merge the USBs for increased efficiency.

Dig Data in Data Diggers, actually you rather download Data with your USBs.
The higher the GB amount of your USB, the faster you can download the data.

title: Beat Music Battle
description: Step into the world of Beat Music Battle: 456 Survival, where rhythm meets creativity and fun! This casual music game is perfect for puzzle enthusiasts and party lovers alike.

title: Knockout Dudes
description: Knockout Dudes is a very cute multiplayer racing game. You will race with other adorable chicks. There are many different and interesting modes you could choose to play. You have to beat others, Win the championship! I believe you will love this game!

title: Aventador Vice Crime City
description: Dive into city driving with four game modes. Navigate realistic traffic and monitor your fuel while exploring busy streets. Enjoy stunning morning city graphics, transforming the city into a spectacle. Pedestrians add unpredictability, and hitting them triggers police chases. Customize your car's appearance and performance. All this chaos is accompanied by your cute dog. Whether evading the cops or just cruising, Aventador Vice Crime City offers a thrilling and visually amazing experience.

title: World Flags Trivia
description: Challenge your geography skills in World Flags Trivia! Identify the nation for each flag from three choices across 194 questions. Perfect your skills as you progress through increasingly tricky questions. Can you score a perfect game and become a true flag expert? Play now and find out!

title: AOD - Art Of Defense
description: Step into the world of AOD - Art Of Defense, a free online strategy game where your main goal is to stop enemy waves by placing towers in smart locations. Play on your phone or computer and test your skills in this action-packed defense challenge. Every move matters—can you build the perfect defense?

title: Jump Ball Classic
description: Jump Ball Classic is the best game to test your reflexes. Move your ball left and right to avoid obstacles and enjoy the thrilling moment! Once it hits, it will fail immediately. Concentrate and challenge for success!

title: Hidden Object Adventure
description: Are you ready to solve puzzles and uncover hidden secrets? Become a detective in Find Hidden Object Game and test your observation skills! Explore detailed scenes in schools, houses, amusement parks, and zoos. Search for cleverly hidden items, challenge your brain, and enjoy fun, relaxing gameplay. Perfect for casual players and puzzle lovers alike. Train your mind and become the ultimate detective!

title: Hidden Mushrooms
description:
Hidden Mushrooms is a game for nature lovers and those who enjoy walking in the woods. Beautiful views of nature in different forests, fields, swamps and other places. Birds singing and cute animals help you relax, and the search for hidden mushrooms captures your attention.
You will spend time usefully, because the game perfectly trains your observation skills!
Do you like hidden object searches? Then be sure to try to find hidden mushrooms!

title: Cookie monster
description: What more could you ask for?! Puzzle, brain teaser, monsters, snacks...wait what? That's right MONSTERS and SNACKS! Feed the hungry monsters snacks to pass the level! You have to make sure all the snacks get into the monster's mouth though or you will see a sad face! Let's keep these monsters happy! If you like the game, leave us a review! That will help us continue to bring you many more challenging levels, new monsters, maybe some new twizzler lines.

title: Sid & Ginny Y2K Glam Clash
description: Welcome to the Y2K style fashion world! Two charismatic heroines are waiting for you, ready to try on fashion trends from the 2000s. Create spectacular makeup for them with lip gloss, shining shadows and glossy skin; choose stylish hairstyles - from smooth straight hair to playful ponytails and fashionable hairpins. Experiment with low-cut jeans, crop tops, mini skirts, shiny fabrics, and bold combinations. Complete the resulting image with iconic accessories of those years.

title: Offroad Island
description: "Offroad Island" is an exciting racing game where you compete with different vehicles, earn money by completing missions, and customize your vehicles by upgrading them. Each map offers an adventure full of challenges. Are you ready for a journey full of speed and excitement?

title: Slope Emoji 2
description: Slope Emoji is a fantastic endless ball rolling game with many emoji balls. Guide a colorful cast of emoji characters down challenging slopes. Test your reflexes with endless series of obstacles, unexpected twists, and surprises. Collect Likes button for more new emoji characters with unique faces! Get ready for the ride of your life and master the art of ball rolling!

title: Happy Fluffy Cubes
description: Happy Fluffy Cubes is a bright and fun 3D runner with adorable cube heroes, tricky traps, and a collection system! Choose your Fluffy and fly through levels full of danger: fire, ice, lasers, and spinning saws! Simple one-touch control, but surviving takes focus and reflexes.

title: Pim Path
description:
Reach the trophy at the end of the level to win, but it's not as easy as it might seem. You can't fall off the platforms; spikes and blades will be everywhere, making the levels more challenging. One wrong step and it's game over.
You'll need to stay calm, pay attention, be agile, have good reflexes, and most importantly, don't get angry.

title: Jewels Blitz Legends
description: Embark on a dazzling adventure in Jewels Blitz Legends, the epic sequel to the beloved Match 3 hit! Travel through ancient Inca temples, uncover mystical secrets, and match colorful gems to unlock treasures. Explore Machu Picchu, complete hundreds of challenging levels, and take on exciting daily missions and weekly events. Collect gold, magical artifacts, and experience stunning visuals in this addictive journey through the heart of ancient legend!

title: Loop Ghost
description: Time loop puzzle: ghosts of your past cycles automatically repeat your moves. Use them to press buttons, open passages, and escape together.

title: Pato Vs Cops
description: lay Pato Vs Cops — the ultimate free browser police chase game! No download needed — jump into nonstop car chases, dodge roadblocks, and outdrive relentless cops in fast-paced arcade action. Perfect for fans of unblocked racing games, endless car chase games, and online driving challenges. Show off your reflexes, collect power-ups, and see how long you can survive the heat in this thrilling high-speed pursuit!

title: Huggy Wuggy Escape
description: Huggy Wuggy Escape is a Poppy Playtime inspired fangame where you have to do 4 simple things in order to win: Find a gun, find some bullets, shoot down Huggy Wuggy and leave the factory before it explode. To kill Huggy you have to shoot him at least six times, but the bullets are rare, so you have to move around the complex looking for them. If Huggy catch you is game over. Once you shot him down, you have to reach the exit in less than 30 seconds.

title: Agent Zero: Infiltration
description: Step into Agent Zero: Infiltration, the ultimate spy game packed with stealth action and secret missions. Sneak past guards, hack security, and escape dangerous traps while completing thrilling puzzles. Perfect for fans searching “stealth game,” “spy puzzle,” or “escape game,” this free adventure tests your skills and strategy. Outsmart enemies, unlock levels, and prove you’re the top undercover agent in this addictive mission challenge!

title: Nuts Stack Sort: Nuts & Bolts
description:
Challenging yet relaxing Nuts & Bolts sort puzzle with a unique twist!

Nuts Stack Sort: Nuts & Bolts is a fun and addictive stack sort puzzle game with a unique twist! Strategically sort and match three same color nuts based on box color in this jam puzzles. Every level offers an exciting challenge in this addictive sort colors puzzle game. Test yourself with this amazing brain teaser!

title: Cargo Path Puzzle
description: Cargo Path Puzzle is a challenging 3D puzzle game that tests both logic and movement strategy. Navigate through complex levels filled with collapsing platforms, ice slides, trampolines, directional blocks, and deadly voids. Every level has only one correct path, so you'll need to think ahead and plan each move wisely. A single wrong step could trap you or block the way forward.

title: Capybara Go!
description: Enter the wonderful world of Capybara. In Capybara Go, begin a strategic adventure. You'll be forming and commanding your own little Capybara army. Defeat your opponents and conquer everything through strategy and combat. Lay out your Capybara's to take advantage of each one's strengths and use strategy to defeat powerful enemies.

title: Super Pop Blast
description: Get ready for a new kind of brick shooter, with unique mechanics, rewarding challenges, and colorful levels. The object: Clear all the blocks using a limited number of balls. Plan your moves, use the score combo system, and try to get 3 stars!

title: Friday Night Sprunki
description: Take on the challenge of a rhythm-based rap battle against many famous characters and hit the correct arrow keys in time with the music that starts playful and energetic but takes on a haunting vibe halfway through. Complete every level to beat the other characters and reach the best score on every Friday weekend. Complete all weeks and be part of the memorable and immersive experience.

title: Robots Gone Wild
description:
Robots Gone Wild is a thrilling survival game in a sci-fi world with captivating visuals and intense shooting mechanics. Your goal is to escape from rogue robots and destroy them while navigating through hazardous environments.

To survive, keep upgrading your character and weapons.
Improve your armor, and unlock powerful guns to fend off waves of increasingly powerful robots. 

Engage in exciting battles, and explore beautiful environments that immerse you in the chaos of a world gone wild.

title: Iconic Halloween Costumes
description: Get ready for a spooky and stylish adventure in Iconic Halloween Costumes! Help three BFFs pick out their perfect Halloween looks, from royal Glinda and Bridgerton-inspired outfits to edgy Beetlejuice vibes and cowgirl-chic styles. Customize their costumes with tops, bottoms, accessories, and makeup to create iconic Halloween outfits. Play now and let the fashion fun begin!

title: Sprunki Garden
description: Welcome to Sprunki Garden – a wild match-3 puzzle adventure inspired by the legendary Sprunki meme! Match colorful Sprunki characters across 100 hilarious levels filled with chaos, charm, and absurdity. Every move connects you with the bizarre Sprunki universe, where each character is weirder than the last. Get ready to swipe, match, and laugh your way through the most brainrotted garden ever!

title: Drunken Fighters
description:
Are you ready for an adrenaline-filled fighting adventure?

Step into the ring in Drunken Fighters’ single-player mode and face opponents that will test your reflexes, or grab a friend and fight in two-player mode on the same device.

Master ragdoll physics and boost the thrill with Funny Mod options: Stretch Kick, Stretch Punch, Big Punch, Super Punch, and Big Head or let Random Mode surprise you with chaos!

title: Vehicle Fun Race
description: Vehicle Fun Race—an exhilarating arcade game with 3D stickman characters. Collect motorcycles, cars, boats, and helicopters to reach the finish line. No need to grab vehicles; your character can handle all terrains. Dive into water? No problem—control their swim. Special helicopters await on final platforms. Ready to race? Let’s roll!

title: Jump Man
description: A highly addictive endless jumper with a super cute but mischievous character! Chain combos and score as high as you can!

title: Sweet Triple Mahjong
description: Sweet Triple Mahjong is a relaxing yet challenging tile-matching puzzle game with a delicious candy theme. Match three identical tiles that are free on the left or right to collect them and clear the board. Each level introduces new tile layouts that test your observation and strategy skills. Easy to learn but hard to master, Sweet Triple Mahjong offers smooth gameplay, colorful visuals, and satisfying progression across multiple levels.

title: Merge Heroes Titans
description:
In this game, you will command squads of melee fighters and ranged archers fighting against waves of enemies. Your agility and strategic thinking will give you an edge to victory.

Unlock new powerful fighters and accurate archers by combining those available for purchase. Place them on the map according to abilities and win.

You will have to discover not only new characters, but also beautiful different worlds, enjoy our new game.

title: Squid Game 3D
description:
Engaging Puzzles: Each level offers a unique challenge, whether it’s rhythm-based action, strategic battles, or construction puzzles.
Diverse Gameplay: No two levels are the same, keeping players engaged and on their toes.
Skill Progression: As you advance, levels become more complex, requiring a blend of quick thinking, strategy, and precise execution.

title: Greek Tower Stacker
description:
Build the tallest structure by stacking beautiful new floors. Each floor contains intricate pillars and arches reminiscent of the mighty Greek civilization.

Challenge yourself to create the most majestic tower in ancient history.

title: Load The Dishes ASMR
description:
Load The Dishes ASMR is a puzzle game that puts you in comfort and fun! Your task is to sort different colored dishes and put them in the dishwasher. By organizing your cutlery in an organized way, you will find that this is not just a simple puzzle challenge, but also a super
relaxing ASMR sound experience.

title: Legend of Fireball
description:
Fireballs are your weapon of choice as you tap on objects to obliterate them and earn rewards. Every tap brings you closer to becoming the ultimate Fireball King! Collect various fireballs, costumes, and upgrades, enhancing your powers with every victory. Master cool fireball skills to crush objects even faster and more efficiently.
Race against time to demolish all targets in thrilling challenges, proving you're the strongest fireball wielder in the universe!

title: 3D Kid Sliding Puzzle
description: We've taken the classic sliding puzzle into a whole new 3D world. Kids will need to slide the scrambled blocks to rearrange them and complete adorable cartoon pictures, such as little animals, vehicles, and fairy-tale characters. The game features vibrant colors and lively 3D models that will immediately capture a child's attention. Not only does it provide hours of fun, but it also helps develop a child's logical thinking, spatial awareness, and problem-solving skills.

title: Pimple Squeeze
description: Dive into ASMR Pimple Pop, the ultimate stress-relief pimple popping game for casual fun! Squeeze, pop, and zap blackheads and pimples with satisfying ASMR sounds and juicy visuals. Enjoy quick arcade-style levels with combo bonuses and quirky faces to clean up. With smooth controls and gross-fun charm, this pimple pop arcade delivers unmatched satisfaction. Ready to pop? Download now and embrace the oddly addictive experience!

title: The Prism City Detectives
description: Embark on a vibrant adventure with "The Prism City Detectives" and join Luna, Ruby, Skye, Willow, Daisy, Violet, and Lumi in restoring color to their monochrome city! Explore dazzling dress-up levels and unravel hidden objects mysteries to find the missing Rainbow Gem and bring back the hues of unity.

title: Jumper's Quest
description:
Jump into a world full of unique obstacles that will test you both mentally and physically. Your quick thinking and reflexes will be put to the test as you decipher puzzles and navigate through each level with finesse.

Encounter a diverse array of enemies, each with their own unique challenges that you must conquer. Intuitive one-touch controls empower you to effortlessly jump through the levels in record time.

title: Ragdoll Bob Puzzle
description: Help Bob reach his goal in Ragdoll Bob Puzzle, a quirky and fun 2D puzzle game that challenges your brain and creativity! Bob is a floppy ragdoll who needs your help to get to the endpoint while collecting as many stars as possible along the way. But here’s the twist—you can’t control Bob directly. Instead, you must guide his path by placing a limited number of blocks and objects in the right spots to create a safe and clever route.

title: Math Block
description: Math Block is a brain-teasing puzzle game where you slide numbered blocks and operators on a grid to form valid math equations. Match the target value using addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division to earn stars and progress through 500 challenging levels!

title: Obby: Gym Simulator, Escape
description:
Help Obby build up his muscles to escape from the castle!
Swing and get bigger!

The game has a rank system.
Defeat bosses, compete with other players for the first place in the ranking!

Spend cups on eggs, collect all the pets.
They will help you swing much faster.

It's up to you to press a barbell, carry weights or lift dumbbells.

title: Find the Sprunki
description: Find out the hidden Sprunki in the specified images. Each level has 12 hidden Sprunki. There are 12 levels in total. The time is limited so be fast and find all hidden objects before time runs out. Clicking in the wrong place several times reduces the time by an additional 5 seconds. So, if you are ready, start the game and have fun!

title: Alchemy Puzzle
description:
We create challenges with fun puzzles, challenge your brain and make you always smile on your lips.
Alchemy Puzzle will help you have moments of light entertainment, combined with puzzle play and fun real life characters.
If you've ever played games: puzzlers, word games, trivia games, quiz games, brain teasers, or just want to spend time have time to relax, let try Alchemy Puzzle, It's for you.

title: Bubble Shooter Billiards & Pool
description: Do you love Pool, Billiards, or Snooker? Now, imagine them combined with your favorite Bubble Shooter game! Bubble Shooter Billiard Pool brings a fresh twist to the classic bubble shooter by blending the thrill of billiards with strategic bubble-popping action. Line up your shots, swap bubbles for the perfect move, and aim for high scores in a vibrant pool hall setting. The crowd is watching—can you master your technique and become the ultimate champion? Play now and find out!

title: King Kong Chaos
description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in King Kong Chaos, a modern 2D pixel art game where players must navigate through perilous levels, dodging spiked balls and barrels hurled by a colossal gorilla. Along the way, pick up the pickaxe strategically to destroy incoming barrels and secure the coveted golden banana to progress.

title: Farm of Words
description: Welcome to the unusual farm. Each farm specializes in growing its agricultural products. Someone grows and sells livestock, while others-cereal, cereals or legumes, and others-breed gardens and grow fruits and so on, there can be many directions. Our farm is unusual, because in the square plots of the Earth you will grow words. Connect the letters on the round field below, they will unite into words that will grow after watering on land tiles in Farm of Words.

title: Survival in Area 51
description: You will play as the character Stas, who works in Area 51. One day, Stas was given a strange task, to find acid and pour it into an unusual device. Then something terrible happened... In Area 51, an explosion occurred underground, and zombies appeared. They began to attack scientists and guards. Your task is to destroy zombies, mercenaries and find a way out of this terrible underground place. The game offers shooting, simple puzzles, a plot, many locations and a final battle.

title: Mahjong Garden
description:
Mahjong Garden offers players the opportunity to enjoy a classic puzzle game with no time limits and on full screen!
In this exciting game you have to connect identical chips in a certain sequence so that they disappear from the field, as well as immerse yourself in oriental culture!
Unlock new tiles and backgrounds to take a look Mahjong in a new way!
Raise your level of logic and visualization, making every move strategic!

title: Puzzle Blocks
description:
Race against time in tense speed battles, employ tactical thinking in rescue missions, and unwind by creating massive structures in free-play mode. Hone your skills assembling perfect puzzles or challenge the ever-accelerating chaos.

Puzzle Blocks is more than a game; it's a curated collection of perfectly crafted puzzles for any mood. The world of puzzles awaits its hero. Can you conquer every challenge?

title: Mall Anomaly
description: Mall Anomaly is not your usual mall trip. Instead of shopping, you’re stuck in endless hallways where mannequins stare, furniture floats, and unusual kitties vanish into thin air. Spot these bizarre anomalies before the place completely glitches out—it’s like spot the difference, but in a cursed shopping center.

title: Dynamons 7
description:
Embark on a brand new Dynamons adventure in Dynamons 7! This online monster collecting game includes two fresh areas to explore; Tall Pines world and the bonus cave.

Seasoned Dynamons connoisseur Jovani will tell you everything you need to know to become a true Dynamon Captain. Encounter Crocynos, Huango, Cybeenyx, Aragonyx and many more special Dynamons. Recruit them for your team and beat others in thrilling 1v1 battles with special attacks and power-ups.

title: Room Sort
description: Welcome to Room Sort - Floor Plan Game, the ultimate free puzzle game that combines the fun of tangram puzzles with the creativity of home design. In this engaging game, you’ll rearrange room blocks to complete floor plans. Each room connects through doors, so you'll need to place them perfectly to create a cohesive layout.

title: Dop Puzzle Erase Master
description:
It is an interesting online game that will take you to an unparalleled puzzle-solving  experience. To solve the puzzles, you may use your imagination and ingenuity. You need to consider what do I erase to pass the level. Within the challenging levels, you  need to use strategic thinking to conquer each puzzle. In each level, you must make use of the
  eraser to erase a part of the picture to show a hidden object or scene. The deletion puzzles are  easy to learn, but challenging to master.

title: Gorilla Adventure
description:
Gorilla Adventure immerses players in an open-world, action-adventure platform game that unfolds within a nocturnal cityscape. In this game, the future's technological advancements have precipitated the downfall of the natural world, plunging players into a mysterious and eerie electronic realm. 

Embark on this journey and master the art of hammer swinging to set new records. Embrace the fury of Gorilla and get ready for an exhilarating climb to the top!

title: Match Tile Royal Family
description: Play an addictive brain challenge in Match Tile Royal Family. This is not just another match puzzle game. It’s a thrilling mix of logic, strategy, and quick thinking. Your goal is simple yet exciting: match tiles of the same design to clear the board. Unlock levels and rescue the royal family from tricky traps. Eliminate blocks, balls, and other objects in a limited number of moves. You can also use power-ups to quickly clear blocks or temporarily freeze obstacles.

title: Ultimate Destruction Simulator
description: Unleash your destructive side in this ultimate demolition experience! Enjoy realistic tower destruction with dynamic physics, and take control of time—slow it down, speed it up, or freeze the action. Experiment with gravity modes, from low to high or even zero gravity, and customize every detail, including debris levels, destructibility, and atmospheric dust. Built for fans of destruction, this game offers the smash-and-crash fun you've been craving!

title: Color It in 3D
description:
Meet the best 3D coloring book!
Relax, immerse yourself in creativity and get inspired!
Draw and create fantasy, cartoon, funny and anime action figures!
If you like 3D character designs, drawing, coloring, then this coloring book is for you.

title: Land Cruiser Offroad Driver
description: Take your cute dog along for a thrilling offroading adventure, and complete 4 awesome game modes across the city map with your awesome SUV. Customize and Upgrade it to your liking and ride in style across the giant offroading map. If you create nuisance in the city, the cops will be on your tail to chase you down. Drift the tires off the SUV and make as much money as you can. Are you ready for this thrilling adventure?

title: Avatar World Secrets
description: Dive into various cute items, design the room setting, dress up your avatar family, and make up a life story as you like. Enjoy the fun interaction with items and characters online.

title: Cut Grass
description: Do you know powerful a ring blade is? Cut Grass will show you a famous Mexican weapon in a 3D collecting puzzle arcade game. Here is some weed on the mud, your mission is to cut them all down at all levels. Without time and score limitations, keep calm and have a good time!

title: Whats Grandma Hiding
description:
Embark on a mysterious journey, where your grandma tasked you with restoring a mansion that you never knew your family had. 

Search for clues scattered throughout the estate, piecing together the mystery and unlocking hidden truths as you delve deeper into the enigmatic past. 

Utilize rewarded ads to gain valuable coins or expedite the deciphering process, enhancing your investigative prowess in this immersive item-searching adventure.

title: Two Stunt Supercars
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning supercar through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: The Final Riddle
description: It's a unique experimental puzzle game, where all you are given is the title of your current puzzle. If you get the hint, you know what to do, how to arrange the blocks and solve the riddle.

title: Craft of Wars
description: The war between the Reds and the Blues has never been more epic than in Craft of Wars! In this cubic game, you'll fight for strategic points on the map using a classic combat system similar to the one found in older versions of Minecraft. Prepare for intense sword and bow duels, TNT explosions, tactical use of potions, and the legendary golden apples that will help you survive the fiercest battles.

title: Shotting Balls
description: In this fun game, you'll have to use your skills to destroy all the black blocks you find in each level in order to advance to the next one. But that's not all: you'll also have to avoid losing the ball, because if it leaves the screen, you'll lose a life and, ultimately, the game. On the other hand, you can also collect gems, which will allow you to obtain new skins to give your ball a new look.

title: Christmas Blind Box‌
description: This is a Christmas toy blind box opening game! Click the "Open" button to test your luck—can you beat the high score for the number of Christmas toys collected?

title: Cool SuperCars Stunts PvP
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning supercar through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Sniper Team 3
description:
Take down waves of enemies using powerful sniper rifles in this action packed shooting game.

Sniper Team 3 is a sniper shooting game where you have to defeat enemy forces with the fire power of your whole team. The missions are a true challenge even for veteran snipers. 

Switch between your team members in real time, and make good use of your scoped rifles, heavy assault weapons and tactical airstrikes.

title: Dear Island
description:
Collect two blocks that match the color of the Match Slot to clear them!
Clear them all to finish the stage!
Blocks of different colors can be placed in the Stock.
If the Stock gets full, it’s game over!

title: Goo Slime Jump
description: Goo Slime Jump is a fun and relaxing casual game, tap to make the slime jump and make sure it reaches the finish line, the relaxing music and calm gameplay make you addicted.

title: Crystal Connect
description: Discover the enchanting world of Crystal Connect, a captivating game with breathtaking graphics! Join a pair of dwarves on an epic quest to collect precious crystals and navigate through dozens of challenging levels in this immersive connect-style adventure game. Connect pairs of gems, create powerful combinations and pave your way to victory. Dive into the adventure today and discover the magic of Crystal Connect

title: Doggo Drop
description: Doggo Drop is a cosy puzzle game where players guide an energetic Shiba Inu as it drops numbered blocks. Land the right blocks to merge them, and reach the best possible score!

title: Mirrors - Puzzle
description: Challenge your mind with Mirrors - Puzzle! In this captivating HTML5 puzzle game, your goal is to connect light dots by reflecting beams of light using mirrors. Strategically place and rotate mirrors to guide the light across the board, linking the dots to complete each level. As you progress, the puzzles become more complex, requiring careful planning and problem-solving skills. With its minimalist design and engaging gameplay, Mirrors - Puzzle offers endless brain-teasing fun on any device.

title: Blackriver Mystery. Hidden Objects
description: "Blackriver: Search for objects" is a new game in which you have to try on the role of a mystical detective, the one who is destined to restore the town from the ruins and solve its mystery. Here you will find a lot of interesting quests, unique collections, popular mini-games (such as three-in-a-row, wheel of fortune and others).

title: School Escape: Obbie Run!
description:
Run Obbie! The teacher will catch up with you and take you straight to the principal! 
You will play as a schoolboy Obbie. After a conflict with the teacher, you need to escape from school. 
The teacher will try to catch up with you at school, you can't let this happen. 
Collect all the keys and escape from school.

title: Rocket Sky!
description: In Rocket Sky! you tap and hold the screen to launch your rocket as far into the sky as you can. Make sure not to overheat though, otherwise it’s game over!

title: Magic and Wizards Match
description: Magic and Wizards is an enchanting Match 3 game where you and your friend Aurora embark on a mystical journey through a magical realm. With over 4000+ levels, match gems representing magical elements to overcome obstacles, using powerful boosters to progress. Complete Daily Missions, tackle tricky blockers, and uncover hidden treasures. With stunning graphics and immersive gameplay, Magic & Wizards delivers a captivating experience filled with mystery. Ready for your magical adventure?

title: Vice City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning sports car through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: Ultimate Tower Defense
description: Ultimate Tower Defense is an exciting strategy game that perfectly blends tower defense, battle, and fast-paced action into one addictive experience. In the game, you must carefully protect defense towers and deploy powerful heroes to stop endless waves of enemies. Each tower has unique attack abilities. Select your preferred mode to begin the challenge.

title: SNAKES
description: SNAKES is a modern puzzle game that combines strategy and spatial reasoning. Players guide multiple snakes across a grid, filling every empty tile to complete each level. With clear visuals and intuitive mechanics, the game offers a relaxing yet challenging experience that sharpens logical thinking. Each level introduces unique layouts and obstacles, ensuring variety and depth as players advance.

title: Squid Sprunki Slither Game 2
description: Squid Sprunki Slither Game 2 is a famous snake-hunting game when Sprunki head and Squid head as main avatar character in this game. You become a small snake that runs endlessly and continuously moves to eat the food, each time it eats it will become longer. Squid Sprunki Slither Game 2 is a simple game that became an instant success soon after its launch.

title: Super Rock Climber
description:
Overcome treacherous obstacles and dizzying landscapes as you control a tenacious climber in this thrilling third-person adventure. Inspired by cult classics such as Overcome This and the challenging climbing game.

Ragdoll Rock Climber is not for the faint of heart - it's for those who crave the thrill of conquering the seemingly impossible. Prove that you are the best climber by posting the best time and overcoming the toughest challenges.

title: Real Driving Simulator
description: Real Driving Simulator is a realistic driving simulation game that lets you fully enjoy the thrill of driving and racing! In this game, you can unblock various vehicles and drive them through cities and tracks. Experience the real feel of being behind the wheel.

title: Real Cars Epic Stunts
description:
Flashy and modified super-sports cars and their drivers are ready for the show in Real Cars Epic Stunts game. Play against time in dozens of different stunt tracks and try to complete the show. Unlock new cars or upgrade your car with the coins and diamonds you collect.

Game Features:

● Realistic car physics and appearance. ( Cars get crushed and smashed )
● Upgradeable cars
● 1 Player and 2 Player modes
● Mega ramps for epic stunts

title: Ball Tower of Hell
description: Ball in hell rolling his way to the top of the tower. There are many difficulties on the way, but the brave ball not scared

title: Magic Kingdom. Hex Match
description: Magic Kingdom: Hex Match is a game where you are the third son of a great king, sent to a distant land to prove your worth. Collect six vital resources—food, water, stone, wood, workers, and metal—to construct new buildings. Unlock all structures and create a stunning, magical kingdom!

title: 3D FPS Target Shooting
description:
3D FPS Target Shooting is an addictive 3D FPS game. The logic of the game is very simple, use your weapon to aim and shoot various targets to get higher scores. Simple and unique gun control experience, aiming and shooting at the targets can be done easily with one hand.Kar98k, M24, and AWM are amazing weapons you can unlock them using the coins you get from passing the levels. The game is
completely free and you can play it online on any device!

title: Oreplication
description: Sandbox strategy tycoon where you design factories for infinite wealth. Start with basic droppers & conveyors, upgrade to advanced machines. Deep progression, mystery boxes, endless optimization—build, outsmart, ascend in the ultimate factory challenge!

title: BURGER CATCH
description: Move the tray left and right to collect the ordered ingredients! If time runs out or you collect too many extra ingredients, you will lose hearts. If you run out of hearts, it's game over.

title: Break the block there, Brainrot!
description:
Break the block there, Brainrot! — Break blocks and collect the entire Brainrot collection.
Sell Brainrots to earn points to upgrade your axe.
Find rare Brainrots in blocks. The further you go to collect the blocks, the greater the reward, but beware of the block guard.

title: Monster Truck Crush
description: Monster Truck Crush is a skillful balanced monster truck racing arcade game. With 3D monster trucks, you need to defeat the AI opponent by arriving at the finish line in the first place. You can speed up immediately when your vehicle is balanced on the next platform. Or else, you will lose some speed or roll the truck. The AI opponent is good at controlling the speed. But you can control the body angle of the car to keep speeding up. Good luck!

title: Cut In Half
description:
Cut obstacles in the way with knives or characters.
If you touch a red block or fall into a valley, it's a game over.
Collect the goods as much as you cut the obstacles to unlock new characters!

title: Grass Land
description: Grass Land is a vibrant exploration game that drops you into a sprawling world of thick greenery and hidden surprises. Take control of your grass cutter, uncover valuable resources beneath the overgrowth, and build up your base as you roam the fields. Stay sharp, move fast, and make the most of every patch of grass you find.

title: Merge Shooter
description: In "Merge Shooter," defend the galaxy by merging turrets to fight off alien invaders. Enhance your defense with special powers, navigating through levels filled with challenges. With its colorful graphics and user-friendly interface, it's an exciting adventure for all ages. Become the galaxy's hero by proving your achievements in this dynamic gameplay experience.

title: Tile Match Cafe
description:
Discover the engaging tile-matching puzzle game that plunges you into a world of triple-tile tapping challenges and stimulating fun.

Prepare yourself for an exciting adventure filled with complex puzzles as you match tiles, clear the boards, and strive to become the top tile master.

With its intuitive mechanics and addictive gameplay, Tile Match Cafe is an ideal pick for fans of tile-matching games seeking a charming and rewarding puzzle experience.

title: Collect Em All
description:
Collect Em All! Is a puzzle game where you connect all the adjacent same colored blocks. Make long chains of colors to create beautiful sounds and unlock explosive power-ups!

Connect the dots to crush them. You can make a limited number of moves, and you cannot go back on yourself, so make sure to plan your path. Create the longest chains for the biggest reward!

 Come back every day to unlock new daily bonuses !

title: Race Time
description:
Race through thrilling tracks in your speedy car! Collect gears to charge up your booster and unleash a powerful speed burst.
Upgrade your car to unlock better performance and purchase the fastest vehicles to dominate the competition.
Use the super boost to knock opponents off the track, climb the leaderboard, and prove you're the ultimate racer.
Beat the clock and challenge your friends online!

title: TicToc Urban Outfits
description: Your favorite influencers are back, and this time, they are getting ready to have fun and dress up in urban fashion!  We've gathered four of our most fashionable BFFs to show you all their hottest looks, so join us in getting started with the TicToc Urban Fashion dress up game for girls, and have a blast choosing their outfit of the day. Experiment with different styles, play with colors and don't forget to use cool accessories for stunning urban looks.

title: Color Sort Mania
description: Forget about everyday life and indulge in a simple world where sorting is an art. Put the bubbles in the most strategic flask and enjoy when everything falls into place.

title: Motor Tour
description: In Motor tour, the ultimate racing game, you'll experience an unforgettable adrenaline-pumping adventure with multiple modes to choose from. Take on fierce competitors, embark on an endless journey, or take things up a notch by daringly weaving through traffic with heart-stopping near misses. Don't wait any longer, start playing now and immerse yourself in this epic experience that is sure to leave you on the edge of your seat!

title: Emoji Frenzy
description:
Test your reflexes and knowledge in this fast-paced emoji matching game! 
Tap the correct emoji before time runs out, build streaks, and unlock new themes. Simple to play, hard to master!

title: Mahjong Match
description: Immerse yourself in our brain games, each level waiting for your mahjong match strategic touch. Your objective? Match three mahjongs of the same color to clear the board puzzle. With every  level presenting an array of mahjong tiles and brain games, the excitement of puzzle games will never wane.
